methodology.title: Question
methodology.body: Do source-company price reactions and disclosed language improve forecasts of peer returns beyond a price-only model? This measures predictive association, not a causal transmission mechanism.

methodology.title: Information clock
methodology.body: SEC Item 2.02 disclosures define events. Features are observed at the close of the first trading session strictly after the filing date. Entry is the following session's adjusted open; exit is the close of the fifth holding session for the default horizon. The deliberate delay avoids trading on ambiguous intraday filing timestamps.

methodology.title: Prices and target
methodology.body: The target is the peer's 5-session adjusted open-to-close return minus SPY's return over the same interval. This is benchmark-relative, not beta-neutral. Yahoo adjusted history is a current vendor snapshot; revision and survivorship limitations remain.

methodology.title: Research universe
methodology.body: AMD, NVIDIA, Intel, Qualcomm, Texas Instruments and Micron form a fixed, retrospectively selected semiconductor cohort. Every other cohort member is a peer. These edges are study assumptions, not verified supplier relationships or a point-in-time industry universe.

methodology.title: Text features
methodology.body: Transparent, fixed phrase rules measure demand, pricing, competitive and guidance language in original SEC filing exhibits. Event labels describe matched language, not verified economic causes. No LLM, later news article or observed future return is used to produce these features. Missing text stays missing and is flagged.

methodology.title: Walk-forward evaluation
methodology.body: Models are fit before each quarterly test block. Only outcomes completed before the cutoff are eligible. A chronological calibration segment is separated from fitting, and overlapping labels are purged. Scaling and ridge coefficients use fitting data only. Hyperparameters are fixed; all displayed forecasts are out of sample.

methodology.title: Uncertainty
methodology.body: Intervals and positive-return probabilities use prior calibration residuals. An 80% interval is nominal; dependent and shifting markets can invalidate coverage. Observed coverage and probability error are reported. MAE comparison intervals resample decision-date clusters; multi-day serial dependence can remain.

methodology.title: Costs and interpretation
methodology.body: A hypothetical SPY-relative position is taken only when the forecast exceeds 20 bps in magnitude. 20 bps is deducted per active trade as an assumed total roundtrip cost. These are overlapping event returns, not portfolio P&L; financing, borrow, capacity and intraday execution are not modeled. No portfolio Sharpe is reported.

methodology.title: What would invalidate the result
methodology.body: A benefit must survive price-only benchmarks, event clustering, alternative costs and future collection. Concurrent peer announcements remain in the sample and can confound interpretation. This pilot is exploratory: repeated model changes after inspecting test results would require a new untouched evaluation period.
